# CodexMeter 1.1.1
CodexMeter 1.1.1 makes the project macOS-only so development, testing, documentation, and releases can concentrate on the native menu bar app.
## macOS focus
- Removes the Windows application and its separate .NET implementation from the current source tree. - Removes Windows build, test, packaging, and release automation. - Simplifies CI and the stable release gate around the Universal 2 macOS app. - Updates the product, architecture, privacy, security, installation, and maintainer documentation to describe one supported platform. - Keeps all existing macOS usage accounting, limits, analytics, settings, launch-at-login, Homebrew, and signed Sparkle update behavior.
Historical tags and changelog entries remain available as an accurate record of previous releases; Windows is no longer part of the supported product or current download path.
## Verification
- Swift unit and integration suite - Signed local Codex app-server limit integration - 10,000- and 100,000-event ingestion stress suite - Universal 2 architecture, bundle metadata, ad-hoc signature, archive, checksum, and Sparkle feed verification
## Install or update with Homebrew
```bash brew update brew upgrade --cask HechoLP/tap/codexmeter xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CodexMeter.app open /Applications/CodexMeter.app ```
Fresh installations can use `brew install --cask HechoLP/tap/codexmeter`.
## First direct-download launch
The app is ad-hoc signed and not Apple-notarized. Download the DMG and `SHA256SUMS.txt` from the official release, verify the checksum, copy `CodexMeter.app` to Applications, and remove quarantine from this app only:
```bash cd ~/Downloads grep ' CodexMeter-1.1.1.dmg$' SHA256SUMS.txt | shasum -a 256 -c - xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CodexMeter.app open /Applications/CodexMeter.app ```
Do not remove quarantine when the checksum does not match the official manifest.
